note: The cancellation and degree-by-degree cost are in `Override.residue`, and the finite-probe cost is paid by `precision_project` (`maxFee + w*u`), instead of an inline argument.

lemma Funds.drop (h : Funds Z M φ T A s c e) (hp : Fits M φ w x A) (hs : u ≤ s)(hv : s ≤ 1)(hu : 0 ≤ u) : Funds Z M φ T A u (c-(w+1:ℝ)*(s-u)) (e-statedProject M w x e) := by
  rcases hs.eq_or_lt with h'|hs
  · subst u; rw [sub_self,mul_zero,sub_zero,sub_eq_add_neg]; exact h.plus hT ((h.allProjected hT H ha hx hu hv hp).funds hv).minus
  refine ⟨loose_diff h.loose ((h.allProjected hT H ha hx (hu.trans hs.le) hv hp).increase_layer hv),fun q=>?_⟩
  let v := min q (q - maxFee M w - w*u)
  obtain ⟨g,hh,hq⟩:= (Matchable.layer hT H ha hs hu hv hx h).replaces v
  refine ⟨(g-statedProject M w x g), hh.residue hT hu hs.le w hx,?_⟩
  have he : Precision Z M φ T A u q (statedProject M w x (e-g)):= by
     apply Against.mono ((precision_project hT hq hp hx hu (loose_diff h.loose ((hh.fine hT hx).increase_layer hv))).tests (Z:=Z) hT H hu (hs.le.trans hv)) le_rfl _ (by rfl)
     linarith only [show v ≤ q-maxFee M w-w*u from min_le_right ..]
  rw [show e-statedProject M w x e-(g-statedProject M w x g) = e-g-statedProject M w x (e-g) from funext fun i=>by simp only [Pi.sub_apply,statedProject,map_sub]; abel]
  exact Against.diff (Against.mono hq le_rfl (min_le_left ..) (by rfl)) he hT

proof_context.conclusion: The residual `e - statedProject w x e` is `Funds` at height `u <= s` and cost `c - (w+1)(s-u)`; for `u = s` it keeps cost `c`.

lemma residue (h : Override Z M φ T x s c e)(hs : 0 ≤ u)(hu : u ≤ s) (w : ℕ) (hx : x∈A) : Fine M φ T A u
      (c - (w+1:ℝ)*(s-u)) (fun i=> M.residue (x i) w (e i)):= by
   induction h with
   | @atom d f h =>
     by_cases he : d ≤ w
     · simp_rw [M.residue_low _ he]; exact .zero
     -- every output of grade ≤w paid with price of same term of grade d
     have he' : (w:ℝ)+1 ≤ d := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.add_one_le_of_lt (not_le.mp he))
     have hl : c-(d:ℝ)*s ≤ c-(w+1:ℝ)*(s-u)-d*u:= by linarith only [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he' (sub_nonneg.mpr hu)]
     let g(i):= M.project (x i) w (insertField D (x i) d (f i)); have hf : RateLE φ T g (c-(d:ℝ)*s):= by
        unfold g; simp_rw [← M.project_through,M.row_of_field]; refine RateLE.sum hT fun j _=>?_
        exact rate_linear (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Z.sector.derivatives.rise (show j.val ≤ w from Nat.le_of_lt_succ j.isLt))) hT (rate_linear (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (M.splitting.part j d)) hT h)
     have hX:= Fine.field (M:=M) hT hx (hp:=h.mono hl)
     exact hX.diff (Fine.field hT hx (hf.mono (hl.trans (by gcongr; omega))))
   | zero=> simp only [Pi.zero_apply,map_zero]; exact .zero
   | plus _ _ hx hy=> simp_rw [Pi.add_apply,map_add]; exact hx.plus hy
   | germ _ h hx=> exact hx.germ (h.mono fun i hi=> congr_arg (M.residue (x i) w) hi)

proof_context.conclusion: For a field of degree `d <= w` the residue is zero, and for `d >= w+1` it has cost `c-(w+1)(s-u)`, including the lower fields produced by the projection.
